name: Polymorphous Rush — any number of target creatures each become a copy of the chosen creature
notes: Sweep group 5, mass copies (2026-10-07). "Choose a creature on the battlefield. Any number of target creatures you control each become a copy of that creature until end of turn." took one target only. The copies are the targets (as many as picked); what is copied is picked with the copy picker. Two of three creatures targeted.
